entries.description: Dockerfile for a Streamlit web UI service. Base: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, copies source, exposes port 8501. CMD: streamlit run frontend/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0.
decision_rules: Always bind to --server.address 0.0.0.0 (not 127.0.0.1) so the container port is reachable externally
Default Streamlit port is 8501 — map to desired host port in docker-compose or Kubernetes
tradeoffs: Single-stage build — suitable for frontend UI services where image size is less critical
No non-root user — add USER directive for security-hardened deployments
anti_patterns: Do not bind to 127.0.0.1 (localhost) inside the container — traffic will not reach the service
Do not hardcode --server.port if flexible port binding across environments is needed
